text:
maya (People Ops): FYI — new review cycle timeline posted. Self-assessments open now and are due by 11:59pm PT on Mon Apr 18. Managers: calibration week is Apr 21–25. Please read the guide and use the manager calibration form: https://redwood.app/docs/perf-cycle-2026 :sparkles:

julian (Eng Manager): thanks! quick Q — is the manager calibration form the same as last cycle's?

maya (People Ops): same flow but updated rubric + a short weighted scoring sheet. link above (section ‘Manager tools’). the scoring sheet is a separate spreadsheet you can download.

carlos (Backend): can managers request a 3-day extension for direct reports who are out?

maya (People Ops): yes — emergency extensions allowed for extenuating circumstances (illness, parental leave). please use the extension request form: https://redwood.app/forms/perf-extension and cc your pplops rep. policy: max 3 business days per person, approvals fast-tracked.

leah (Recruiting): tagging — does calibration include new hires who started within the last 30 days?

maya (People Ops): short answer: no formal rating for hires <30 days. leave qualitative notes in the review form so hiring team has context.

julian (Eng Manager): scheduling note: can we get one dedicated 90-min slot for Eng calibrations? we had timezone split trouble last cycle.

srini (Director): I can block a 90-min window Thu Apr 24 10–11:30 PT for Eng + Product calibrations. if folks need other times, ping me and we'll add another.

maya (People Ops): thanks Srini — I’ll update the calendar shares. Manager checklist snippets below for copy/paste into invites:

```
Subject: Calibration — Team X
Agenda: 1) Quick context (5m) 2) Review borderline cases (60m) 3) Agree on ratings + calibration notes (20m)
Prep: bring scoring sheet + 2 example prompts for quality review
```

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Self-assessment due in 7 days" will post to channels: #people-ops, #eng. (automated)

carlos (Backend): pinging about one more thing — is there a template for self-assessment goals?

maya (People Ops): yes — use the Self-Assessment Template in the docs (link in guide). TL;DR: 3 bullets: what worked, top impact examples (with metrics if possible), development goals for next cycle. try to keep to ~250–400 words.

julian (Eng Manager): noted. also, how do we surface calibration outcomes back to ICs?

maya (People Ops): managers will enter final ratings into the form; an email will be autogenerated by peopleops-bot to each direct report with summary + manager comments. timing: expect those emails within 3 business days after your calibration slot.

leah (Recruiting): one request from hiring ops — can managers add notes about ramp plans for new hires in the ‘Onboarding & Ramp’ field? helps hiring and L&D coordinate.

maya (People Ops): absolutely — added to manager checklist.

carlos (Backend): quick ask — I might need the 3-day extension for one report. filed the form just now. :pray:

maya (People Ops): got it, Carlos — seeing the form now, will confirm by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

srini (Director): thumbs up. please keep calibration notes concise so they can be audited if needed.

maya (People Ops): final reminder: if you haven't started self-assessments, please do in the next week. reach out in thread or DM your pplops rep for questions. :bell:
